ideas.pitch: An edge-AI platform utilizing local sensor telemetry and drone imagery to predict crop stress and yield anomalies instantly.
ideas.title: AgriSensor-ML: Real-time Crop Disease and Soil Anomaly Detection
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages heavy AI/ML focus from the hosting CSE (AI & ML and Data Science) departments with a robust, working demo combining sensor data and image classification.

ideas.pitch: A localized IoT dashboard that monitors campus power consumption, detects anomalies using fast ML, and automates energy-saving routines.
ideas.title: SmartCampus Energy Ops: Autonomous IoT Power Grid Diagnostic
ideas.why_it_could_win: Features hard systems engineering with real-time anomaly detection and a functional dashboard that judges can interact with live.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered video intelligence platform that indexes campus lecture recordings, making spoken content, slides, and code searchable instantly.
ideas.title: EduLens AI: Unstructured Lecture Video Search & Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: Directly targets institutional utility at an engineering college by solving the common student problem of navigating massive video archives.

ideas.pitch: An explainable AI platform designed for college placement cells to detect, explain, and mitigate bias in automated candidate shortlisting algorithms.
ideas.title: FairHiring AI: Bias Detection in Student Placement Resumes
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies cutting-edge fairness and interpretability techniques (SHAP/bias scoring) to a high-stakes domain relevant to every engineering college student.

ideas.pitch: An agentic data tool that converts raw CSV datasets uploaded by students into fully interactive analytics dashboards in seconds via text prompts.
ideas.title: DataViz-Gen: Text-to-Analytics Dashboard Generator
ideas.why_it_could_win: Showcases impressive agentic workflows and automated UI generation that yields an instantly demonstrable, flashy working product.
